onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/category.schema.json, set smc_jump_from to {{smc_jump_from}}]
Configure the Jumping state's allowedFrom list in CharacterStateMachine to {{smc_jump_from}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/category.schema.json, set smc_dash_from to {{smc_dash_from}}]
Configure the Dashing state's allowedFrom list in CharacterStateMachine to {{smc_dash_from}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/category.schema.json, set smc_abort_jump to {{smc_abort_jump}}]
Set variable jump height (handleJumpRelease calling abortJump) to {{smc_abort_jump}} in CharacterStateMachine.
